beginner.headline: Today (Mon Oct 19): conditional for beginners, best 6:45–9:00 AM. Canoes forecast 1–2 ft (knee to thigh, Surfline) on a small S/SW mix with 12 s and 15–17 s components. Trades already gusty at dawn (Honolulu NE 9 mph gusting 24 at 6 AM) and building to E 17–19 mph by mid-morning (NWS). Tide rising to the 11:26 AM high (1.8 ft). 9:00–11:00 AM conditional; from 11:00 AM not recommended.
beginner.recommendation: Go early and keep it short if the wind is already pushing. At 6 AM Honolulu airport was NE 9 mph gusting 24 (much lighter than last evening's NE 18 gusting 32), and the NWS point forecast for Honolulu builds E 17 mph by 8 AM and 18–19 mph from late morning, so the lighter-wind window is the first two hours of daylight. Surf at Canoes looks small (Surfline 1–2 ft, knee to thigh; 'small leftovers, waist high and below'), but the mix includes 15–17 s energy, so watch several full set cycles (10+ minutes) before committing. NWS has scattered showers this morning (30% chance, Honolulu Metro) after night showers with some leeward spillover: check water color at Canoes and toward the Kūhiō drains and Ala Wai side; the DOH list could not be read. One student or a small group of strong adults; several students or children only if drift is low. Your on-site read overrides this report.
